title: Pilates
statementMd:
After years of training for programming contests, MkVeio wants a more physically active routine. While looking for an enjoyable activity, he discovers Pilates!

Pilates is an exercise method developed by Joseph Pilates that emphasizes the connection between mind and body. At MkVeio's studio, workouts cycle through four pieces of equipment in this order:

1. `Reformer`;
2. `Cadillac`;
3. `Chair`;
4. `Barrel`.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c7be88be6e48a61536d8e773f33b10209527bdd.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/41d5017332bab2d0430936c266649db3f3e08108.png)1. Reformer2. Cadillac![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a8b3754c25b993937c924a5c170f12cdc9c3b05a.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9816b13607cd1c20861be27603c3b259eb584be2.png)3. Chair4. Barrel

The first workout uses the `Reformer`, the second the `Cadillac`, the third the `Chair`, and the fourth the `Barrel`. The fifth returns to the `Reformer`, and the cycle continues.

MkVeio has signed up for 𝑛n workouts before the end of the year. He is very disciplined and is certain he will attend them all. Which piece of equipment will he use in his last workout of the year?

In his prime, MkVeio would have written a program to answer this in under a minute, but he is tired and would rather ask for your help.

## Input

The input consists of a single line containing an integer 𝑛n (1≤𝑛≤1051≤n≤105), the number of workouts MkVeio will attend before the end of the year.

## Output

Print the name of the equipment used in his 𝑛n-th workout: `Reformer`, `Cadillac`, `Chair`, or `Barrel`.
